checks.check: script exists and is executable (test no longer chmods it)
output is a JSON object with usb, cpu, storage, audit_timestamp
checks.requirement: Output a valid JSON file to /tmp/hardware_audit.json; The JSON output structure should follow this format

checks.check: non-zero root_hubs equal the live system's root hubs (sysfs usbN/version or lsusb 1d6b:000N)
checks.requirement: Detect all USB root hubs and their versions; Count how many root hubs exist for each USB version
checks.note: zero-count keys optional; keys restricted to 1.0..3.2

checks.check: max_version = highest version present; null/'unknown' if none
checks.requirement: Report the highest USB version supported by the system

checks.check: has_usb3 boolean consistent with max version >= 3.0
checks.requirement: Determine if the system has USB 3.0 or higher support

checks.check: cpu.cores integer equal to physical core count (cores/socket x sockets or unique core ids)
cpu.threads integer equal to logical CPU count (lscpu CPU(s)/nproc/getconf); threads >= cores
features: non-empty list of real CPU flags including aes/avx/avx2/sse4_1 where the CPU has them
checks.requirement: Detect CPU feature flags (e.g., aes, avx, avx2, sse4_1, etc.)
checks.note: full list vs subset is contested; only the weaker property is checked

checks.check: every lsblk disk listed, all names real, disk type from nvme name/ROTA
checks.requirement: List all block devices with their type (HDD, SSD, NVMe)

checks.check: size_gb within [bytes/2^30-1, bytes/1e9+1]; total = sum of size_gb within max(1, n)
checks.requirement: Report total storage capacity in GB
checks.note: GB vs GiB and rounding not fixed by the task; both accepted

checks.check: type_summary ssd/hdd/nvme integers equal counts in devices
checks.requirement: Create a summary of storage device types

checks.check: audit_timestamp extended ISO 8601 and within 15 min of the run
checks.requirement: Include an ISO 8601 formatted timestamp in the output

checks.check: with a failing lsusb on PATH the script still writes valid JSON with all sections
checks.requirement: Handle missing or unavailable information gracefully

contested.verifier_expects: anything between GiB-1 and GB+1 per device; total = sum of listed sizes
contested.why: task says GB without saying 1e9 or 2^30, or how to round

contested.verifier_expects: subset of real flags including aes/avx/avx2/sse4_1 if present
contested.candidates_give: all flags (A, B) or a filtered list (D)
contested.why: task says 'e.g.' and its example lists only five

contested.value: whether non-disk block devices (rom, partitions) are listed
contested.verifier_expects: all disks required; extra real devices allowed
contested.why: 'all block devices' with only HDD/SSD/NVMe types
